verdict.rationale:
GrowthBook ships an official MCP server that bridges AI tools (Cursor, VS Code, Claude) to a full REST API, explicitly loading 'GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails)' for authenticated programmatic access to feature/experiment data, and the REST API plus experiment-results docs (Chance to Win, stats engine) provide the read access needed to summarize outcomes. This directly targets the AI-agent read-and-recommend workflow described in the story.
Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of an agent using MCP to produce a ship/rollback recommendation, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP+Agent Skills workflow beyond vendor docs.
